annotations.title: Live availability: can this be bought or booked right now?

description: Live buy/book check on any product or booking page: can it be purchased right now, at what price, in which options (sizes, colours, dates, rooms), which option matches the variant you name, quantity and ship-to eligibility where the page states them, with evidence and a checked_at stamp. Read at call time: schema.org JSON-LD, Open Graph and Shopify product JSON first; a browser render and Gemini only when the page gives machines nothing. Input: url; optional variant, quantity, ship_to, language. $0.50 per call. Returns: available, availability, price, currency, options[], matched_option, quantity_ok, ship_to_ok, shipping, eligibility_notes[], evidence[], source, confidence, checked_at.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, pt-BR, zh-Hant): every prose field of the answer is written in this language. Default: the language of the material or question.

ship_to.description: Optional: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the order ships to.

url.description: The product, listing or booking page.

variant.description: Optional: the option you want, in words (size 9 natural black; double room 12 Oct; economy).

name: hubvibe_commerce_availability

outputSchema.description: The 200 body of every paid /work call. `result` is the worker's own output (its schema is per route); everything else is the same on every /work route. A receipt for the job is at `receipt_url`.

attribution.description: Present only when the result's text was machine-translated: the credit to show with it.

billing_warning.description: Present only when the charge was recorded with a caveat.

price_usd.description: What this call cost, in USD.

provenance.description: How the result was produced: which providers ran and how long each took.

attempts.description: Provider attempts made, including retries and failovers.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for the whole job.

steps.description: Every step the job ran, in order.

reason.description: Failure reason, on a failed step.

receipt_url.description: Where to fetch the machine-readable receipt (free, no payment).

availability.description: Availability of the option asked for (or of the product when no variant was named).

available.description: Purchasable or bookable right now under the conditions asked; null when the page does not say.

checked_at.description: When the page was read (UTC). The answer was true at this moment; nothing here is cached.

confidence.description: high: exact structured data for the option asked; medium: page-level tags only; low: model reading or nothing found.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of `price`; null when not stated.

items.description: A restriction or caveat the page states, or why a condition could not be checked.
examples: Ships to US, CA and GB only.

evidence.description: The evidence behind the answer, best first.

items.description: What the answer rests on: a structured-data field or an exact quote from the page.
examples: JSON-LD Offer availability https://schema.org/InStock price 110 USD

http_status.description: HTTP status of the page fetch.

javascript_rendered.description: Whether a real browser had to render the page to answer.

language.description: BCP-47 tag the prose fields were written in; null for the page's own language.

matched_option.description: The option matching `variant`; null when no variant was asked or none matched.

available.description: Purchasable now; null when the page does not say.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; null when not stated.

name.description: The option as the page names it.

price.description: Price of this option; null when not stated.

sku.description: SKU when the page states one.

url.description: Option-specific URL when the page gives one.

model.description: The model used, only when the model layer ran.

options.description: Every purchasable variation the page lists (sizes, colours, dates, rooms, fares).

available.description: Purchasable now; null when the page does not say.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; null when not stated.

name.description: The option as the page names it.

price.description: Price of this option; null when not stated.

sku.description: SKU when the page states one.

url.description: Option-specific URL when the page gives one.

options_count.description: How many options the page lists.

price.description: Price of the matched option, else the product's; null when not stated.

quantity_ok.description: Whether that quantity can be ordered; null when the page does not say.

ship_to_ok.description: Whether the page says it delivers there; null when it does not say.

shipping.description: What the page states about shipping or delivery; null unless stated.

source.description: Which layer answered: the page's JSON-LD, the Shopify product JSON, Open Graph tags, the model over the rendered page, or nothing usable.

title.description: Product or listing name from the page.

variant.description: The variant asked for, as given.

status.description: Present only on a delivered result.

worker.description: Catalog name of the worker that ran.
